floorPlans.introduction: Compare four-bedroom semi-detached and five-bedroom standalone villas, with mirrored versions of both. The complete sheets show ground, first and second floors.
floorPlans.note: The displayed total combines suite, garage and balcony areas. The source gives separate plot sizes. Confirm the plot and signed layout for your villa.

review.images: Reviewed seven official gallery frames and the wide hero. Omitted the duplicate narrower five-bedroom exterior. The wide villa elevation supplies the card, with bedroom and living room views in the editorial panels.
review.location: Matched the Fairway Villas 3 named map point and Emaar South map. Emaar’s brochure physical page 5 names Expo City and the airport without timings. The launch fact sheet hosted by Mitchell’s matches the cached original SHA-256 1552aca499c26cf92c0826fffe601719231cebb03ba6300815fb6324fd652f7f and provides four drive estimates. The independent InvestInDXB mirror corroborates them. Property Finder estimates five minutes to the airport, so the developer’s seven-minute launch estimate is specifically credited.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all five physical PDF pages. Displayed the four residence drawings, with standard and mirrored versions of both sizes, retaining key plans and all levels. Verified all four area panels visually and checked each component against PDF text and the printed totals.

unavailable: Live driving times, plot entrance coordinates and signed plot-specific layouts were not verified.
